content_of_post_to_answer: How do you know when you need mental health support?
answer: You don't have to reach a breaking point to deserve mental health support. A useful signal is when your usual ways of coping stop working, or when ordinary responsibilities require more emotional effort than they used to. You may still function well while quietly struggling. I've explored this distinction further on my Quora profile, because appearing okay and actually being okay are not the same thing.
